projects.name: Stress Tester & Local Judge
projects.concepts: Random test generators, brute-force vs optimised comparison, time limits, complexity
projects.desc: CLI tool that generates random tests, runs a brute-force and an optimised solution, diffs outputs and reports the first failing case plus run times.
projects.miles: M1: generator + runner (L3) | M2: diff + minimal failing case + timing report (L4)

projects.name: In-Memory Key-Value Store with LRU/LFU & TTL
projects.concepts: Hash maps, doubly linked lists, heaps (TTL expiry), design trade-offs
projects.desc: Redis-like store with GET/SET/DEL, a pluggable LRU or LFU eviction policy, key TTL via a min-heap, and a benchmark harness comparing policies.
projects.miles: M1: core map + LRU (L10) | M2: LFU + TTL heap (L13) | M3: benchmarks + tests (L14)
projects.rubric: Correctness & complexity 40% · Tests 20% · Design & code quality 20% · Benchmark report 20%

projects.name: City Route Planner
projects.concepts: BFS, Dijkstra, A*, 0-1 BFS, MST, DSU, graph modelling
projects.desc: Load a city/metro graph and answer shortest-route, fewest-transfers (state graph) and minimum-cable-network (MST) queries. Visualise the paths.
projects.miles: M1: graph loader + BFS/Dijkstra | M2: A* + transfers | M3: MST + visualisation + benchmark
projects.rubric: Algorithms 40% · Correctness on test maps 20% · UI/visualisation 20% · Report 20%

projects.name: Rate Limiter & Job Scheduler
projects.concepts: Sliding window, deques, token bucket, heaps, interval scheduling
projects.desc: Library with fixed-window, sliding-log and token-bucket rate limiters, plus a priority job scheduler with deadlines. Includes a simulator replaying request traces.
projects.miles: M1: 3 limiter algorithms | M2: scheduler with heap | M3: simulator + comparison report

projects.name: Codeforces Profile Analyser & Problem Recommender
projects.concepts: Hashing, sorting, heaps (top-k), prefix sums over time, binary search on rating
projects.desc: Pulls a user's submissions from the public Codeforces API, computes tag strengths and weaknesses and rating progress, and recommends unsolved problems near the user's rating in weak tags.
projects.miles: M1: API client + caching | M2: analytics (tags, verdicts, timeline) | M3: recommender + report
projects.rubric: Data handling 30% · Analytics correctness 30% · Recommendation quality 20% · UX/report 20%

projects.name: Capstone: Mini Search Engine
projects.concepts: Tries, inverted index, hashing, heaps (top-k ranking), edit distance (did-you-mean), segment tree / BIT for analytics
projects.desc: Indexes a document corpus, supports prefix autocomplete (trie), ranked keyword search (TF-IDF + top-k heap), spell correction (edit distance) and a query-analytics dashboard. Exposed via REST API or CLI.
projects.miles: M1: tokenizer + inverted index (L35) | M2: ranking + autocomplete (L36) | M3: spell-check + API + demo (L40)
projects.rubric: Algorithms & complexity 35% · Feature completeness 25% · Code quality & tests 20% · Demo & viva 20%
